spans.s:
r. 4th cl. (उच्यति)
To be conglomerate, to be gathered or assembled together, to unite or associate with.

mfn. (-च्चः-च्चा-च्चं)
High, tall.
m. (-च्चः)
The apex of the orbit of a planet.
E.
उत् upwards, चि to gather, and ड aff.

ind.
Excessively lofty, tall, loud, &c.
E.
उच्च high, कैस् aff.

n. (-नं)
Laughter in the mind not expressed in the countenance.

f. (-टा)
1 Pride, arrogance.
2 Habit, usage.
3 A kind of garlic.
4 A species of grass, (a cyperus.)
5 A shrub, (Abrus precatorius.)
6 A sort of sorrel.
E.
उत् and चट to injure, अच् and टाप् affs.

mfn. (-ण्डः-ण्डा-ण्डं)
1 Quick, expeditious.
2 Passionate, violent.
E.
उत् implying excess, चडि to be angry, and अच् aff.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Highest.
E.
उच्च and तमप् aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Higher, more lofty.
E.
उच्च and तरप् aff.

m. (-रुः)
1 The cocoanut tree.
2 Any lofty tree.
E.
उच्च and तरु a tree.

f. (-ता)
Height; also n. (-त्वं).
E.
तल् or त्व added to उच्च.

n. (-लं)
Music and dancing at feasts, drinking parties, &c.
E.
उच्च high sounding, and ताल tune.

m. (-वः)
A name of KṚṢṆA.
E.
उच्च high, above, and देव a deity.

f. (-ता)
Time personified, Chronos.
E.
उच्च high, and देवता divinity.

m. (-न्द्रः)
The end of the night, the last watch of the night.
E.
उत् priv. and चन्द्र the moon; moonset.

n. (-णं)
Speaking loud.
E.
उच्च and भाषण speaking.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
To be said.
E.
वच to speak, pass. v., शानच् aff.

m. (-यः)
1 The knot of the string or of the cloth which fastens the lower garments round the loins tied in front.
2 The opposite leg of a triangle.
E.
उत् up, above, चि to gather, अच् aff.

n. (-णं)
1 Uttering, articulating.
2 Going up or out.
E.
उत् before चर to go, ल्युट् aff.

n. (-णं)
Articulating, enunciation.
E.
उत् before चर to go, causal form, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Uttered, articulated.
2 Gone up or out.
E.
उत् before चर to go, क्त aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Pronounced, uttered, articulated.
E.
उत् before चर to go, causal form, क्त aff.

n. (-लं)
The mind, the understanding.
E.
उत् above, and चल what goes.

n. (-नं)
Going off or out.
E.
उत् before चल to go, ल्युट् aff.

f. (-टा)
A woman with a high or projecting forehead.
E.
उच्च high, and ललाट a forehead; also उच्चललाटिका.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Gone up or out.
2 Winnowed.
E.
उत् before चल to go, क्त aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Eradicating as a plant.
2 Ruining, (as an individual.)
3 Causing a person's ruin by magical incantations.
E.
उच्च up, and अटन going.

m. (-रः)
1 Foeces, excrement.
2 Pronunciation, utterance.
E.
उत्, चर to go, and घञ् aff.

m. (-ज्ञः)
A linguist, one skilled in languages or sounds.
E.
उच्चारण and ज्ञ who knows.

n. (-नं)
The part of the throat, &c. whence certain sounds, as nasals, gutturals, and the like proceed.
E.
उच्चारण and स्थान place.

mfn. (-थ-र्था-र्थं)
Necessary for pronunciation, a superfluous letter, &c. उच्चारण and अर्थ object.

ind.
Having spoken or uttered.
mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं)
To be spoken, to be pronounced.
E.
उद before चर to go, causal form, affix ल्यप् or यत्.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Being uttered or pronounced.
E.
उच्चर, causal form, शानच् aff.

mfn. (-चः-चा-चं)
1 Various, multiform.
2 Uneven, irregular, undulating.
3 High and low.
E.
उदक् upper, and अवाक् lower, great and small, &c.; the compound is irregular.
